response.sql:
SELECT AVG(media_type_avg_bytes_per_ms)
FROM (
  SELECT mt.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track AS t
  JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
) AS per_media_type

assumptions.assumption: “Pass a cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes” means strictly greater than the cutoff; each media type’s average includes only tracks passing it, and the final average weights each represented media type equally.

alternatives.interpretation: If tracks exactly at the cutoff should also pass, use an inclusive cutoff.
